description: Material-specific screening properties for the premade C-horn walking-load envelope. Strength values are conservative allowables, not vendor certifications.

material.name: PETG 25% infill
material.assumption: Upper yaw-bearing radial reaction resolves across the measured 56.3 mm upper/lower bearing-center span; the compact cartridge does not carry the full hip-pitch moment over its local 15 mm contact spacing.

material.name: unknown aluminum C-horn; conservative allowable
material.assumption: Alloy and temper are unverified; 110 MPa is used instead of 6061-T6 yield.

material.name: carbon tube isotropic bending proxy
material.assumption: Conservative longitudinal bending allowable for an unverified 8 mm OD / 6 mm ID tube; not a laminate or socket-crush model.

material.name: TPU 95A linear secant proxy
material.assumption: Linear small-strain proxy for a hyperelastic printed boot; stress utilization is screening-only and displacement is approximate.
